criteria: 1: worth a glance only if he happens to look up
worth_interrupting.instructions: Score how much this message justifies breaking into Casey Miyamoto's attention while he is walking. Judge only what the text supports, not its tone. A 2 requires a concrete consequence and a deadline.

exam_dependent.instructions: Is this a case where the absence of a reply will itself cause a real, concrete loss (a missed meeting, a failed deploy, an expiring credential), rather than merely being missed information?
